title: Countable products in the derived category
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core, the derived category has countable products.

proof.text: Construct products by termwise products of representative complexes and descend their universal property through the derived localization. Exact countable products preserve quasi-isomorphisms, and the localization fraction calculus gives the product cone.
